notes.title: 3D Game of Life: Float
notes.notes: If the number of neighbors of cells in the three-dimensional Game of Life could be a decimal...

notes.title: Try unlock 9999x9999x9999 (Better not, Unless your computer is very,very good..)
notes.notes:
9999x9999x9999     approximately equal to     1.000.000.000.000 (One Trillion) !!!

So please set it carefully after unlocking it 0.0...

notes.title: Game of Life: Float
notes.notes:
Suppose cells are not born and die instantly, but need to slowly go from 0 to 1, and from 1 to 0. 
Therefore, the number of neighbors may not be an integer, but may be [b]float[/b]
